name: Kandle
description: Lets an agent drive Kandle, an open-source browser charting app for crypto, stocks and forex: read candles and indicator values, draw levels, set alerts, run scripts with strategy backtests and take screenshots (26 tools). Crypto data needs no API key; the server talks to the open Kandle tab over a WebSocket on 127.0.0.1. Install: `npx -y --package=https://github.com/Kernel-Hunter/kandle/releases/download/v0.10.1/kandle-mcp-0.10.1.tgz kandle-mcp` · [App](https://kernel-hunter.github.io/kandle/)
